description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractField' implementing 'FieldInterface' for CRON expression field handling, including methods for evaluating if certain date values satisfy CRON field conditions such as ranges, increments, and specific matches.

classes.name: AbstractField
classes.description: An abstract class for CRON expression fields that provides methods to determine if a given date value satisfies field criteria such as ranges, increments, and exact matches.

methods.name: isSatisfied
methods.description: Determines if a date value satisfies the field's conditions, checking for increments, ranges, or direct matches.

methods.name: isRange
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is a range, identified by a hyphen.

methods.name: isIncrementsOfRanges
methods.description: Checks if the value specifies increments within a range, indicated by a slash.

methods.name: isInRange
methods.description: Determines if a date value falls within a specified range.

methods.name: isInIncrementsOfRanges
methods.description: Checks if a date value fits within an increments of range pattern, considering step size and offset.
